sizing.capsule_count_note: not in chip spec; sheet default 100,000 used

scenario.description: No scenario file: the sim adapter records the commands the planner sent and nothing else. No virtual chip, no sensors and no injected faults, so there is no reality to configure - and nothing was measured, which is why simulated_hardware is true.

events.narration: Load the capsule suspension into the exchange chamber; the weir holds the capsules back. One chamber volume: a load FILLS the chamber, so the chamber's own volume (3.638 uL) is the only sensible number. This step used to say 100 uL, 27x what the chamber holds.
Wash the capsules three times with wash buffer to clear the loading liquid. SWEEP: 1.54 chamber volumes per wash, 4.62 in total, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs.

Swap in lysis buffer to open the cells, keeping the capsules on the weir. SWEEP, not a fill: the chamber is full of wash buffer, so one chamber volume would leave over a third of it behind and dilute the lysis chemistry by the same share. 4.62 chamber volumes in one pass.
Wash the lysis buffer out three times. SWEEP: 4.62 chamber volumes in total, because carryover into the RT step is exactly what this step exists to prevent.
Exchange into the RT mix. SWEEP: an enzyme mix has to arrive undiluted, so this clears the wash buffer rather than topping it up.
Hold the exchange chamber warm while the RT mix works.
Split the capsules evenly into the four split chambers.

Give split chamber 1 its own reagent, A. SWEEP of the SPLIT chamber: 4.63 of its 1.273 uL volumes, not of the exchange chamber's. Each split chamber arrives full of RT mix, and the point of a split is that the four get DIFFERENT reagents, so carryover is what would blur them together.
Give split chamber 2 reagent B. SWEEP: 4.63 split-chamber volumes.
Give split chamber 3 reagent C. SWEEP: 4.63 split-chamber volumes.
Give split chamber 4 reagent D. SWEEP: 4.63 split-chamber volumes.
Pool the capsules from all four split chambers back into one chamber.
Wash the pooled capsules three times. SWEEP: 1.55 pool-chamber volumes (2.911 uL each) per wash, 4.64 in total.
Release the library from the capsules and send it to the outlet for collection. 3.9 pool-chamber volumes, which is -ln(1 - 0.98) for the release.target_fraction goal rather than the exchange one.
